transcript.text: Thank you, Elena. I'd like to raise a significant participation barrier I've observed. In 6 of the last 8 live sessions, remote members were unable to submit questions or vote because no one was monitoring the chat. This is a recurring issue that's effectively excluding a portion of our membership from full participation. I'd like to propose that the new charter require every session to include a moderated remote question-and-vote channel so remote members can reliably engage going forward.

transcript.text: Thank you, Elena. I do have a perspective on both points. On the leadership transition: I can confirm that Marcus and I did discuss a 90-day transition term where I would step into the chair role, and I appreciate him putting that on the table today. I'd welcome that being formally captured in the draft charter. On the participation barrier I raised — the moderated remote question-and-vote channel needs to be more than a one-time fix. I'd recommend the charter specify a designated chat moderator for every monthly session, with a backup assigned in advance, so remote members never lose their ability to submit questions and vote due to an oversight. This should be a standing practice, not an ad hoc one. I don't have additional existing commitments or barriers beyond what's already been shared, but I'm happy to answer any further questions Elena or the group may have.
